ratings_why.fun: Three builds pulling one IOU pile three ways is a real draft choice, but ten Debt rules make each turn read like bookkeeping before it feels like a heist.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: no tribe today borrows against its own future, and the same Debt counter is a cost to the collector, fuel to the carrier and a target to the skimmer.

verdict_why: The core reads well now, but Debt taken between turns (Silas) has no clear Fresh timing, and a few texts are too long to read at a glance.

points.text: Silas Owes 4 after the fight, between turns, so a player can't tell if that Debt is Fresh through the next turn or can be Paid and Skimmed at once. Say which; Protection Racket assumes Skim clears it.
Ten keywords is a lot to hold. Fold Fresh Debt, Clear and Start of Turn order into the IOU pile's display, so the card text only ever says Owe, clear, Skim and Ledger.
Sorrow and Joy's text explains itself three times. Something like "Each Debt you clear counts twice for your Ledger and for counting cards" reads at a glance.

The crime family comes through in play (loans, fences, protection, theft), but the corvids barely do. A card that hides a cache and moves it when watched, or a jackdaw mob on a remembered enemy, would make them birds as well as gangsters.
Seven's exactly-7 is a fine puzzle if the IOU pile shows what Debt will be at Start of Combat after End of Turn Owes; without that preview it reads as a gamble.

standouts.why: Seven is the rhyme turned into a rule: one number, one condition, instantly readable and a real puzzle.
Uncle Jack reads in one line and changes how you plan the whole game: the pawnbroker lends you your next tier.
Thorn Nest Fence is the fantasy in one trigger: sell the goods, pay the debt, and it reaches into every other tribe.

weakest.why: The most important multiplier is the hardest card to read, with three sentences of exceptions.
Gallows Lane Bagman's partial-miss rule is hard to follow when several Skims resolve in a row.
Wassail Bowl-Bearer is a plain Attack buffer; the tribute bowl doesn't show in what it does.

flags.note: Debt Owed after a fight has no stated Fresh timing.
A credit Tier up every turn may still be the best play in any lobby; golden does it twice.
Arne with 30 Debt gives +10/+10 to every unit, as the design intends; worth the owner's eye beside Uncle Jack.
